scope: What of Artaud is in the public domain in the United States and was found open: the correspondence with Jacques Rivière as first printed in La Nouvelle Revue française of 1 September 1924, and L'Art et la mort (1929) in its first edition. QUEUED: L'Ombilic des limbes and Le Pèse-nerfs (1925), not found in an open scan. Not seated: Le Théâtre et son double (1938) and Pour en finir avec le jugement de dieu (recorded 1947, printed 1948), the text of the body without organs, in copyright in the United States until 2034 and 2044.

why_seated: MANUS, 27 October 2026, after the twenty-sixth seating: "deleuze and guattari... no way around that copyright, huh?" Told that every route through it is closed for decades, and offered a declared absence for them and the open sources they read: "yes - i cant believe we havent seated spinoza yet. yes to all" — and "and leibniz' monodology only". Artaud is seated as the source of the body without organs, which Deleuze and Guattari take from him in L'Anti-Œdipe (1972) and Mille plateaux (1980, plateau 6).
ruling: Seated in the language each wrote in, as far as the public domain of the United States reaches and an open witness was found, beside the declared absence of Deleuze and Guattari (27/07) (MANUS, 2026-10-27).
